headline: Creative systems emergency declared
script: This is Squilliam Fancy Son, declaring a creative systems emergency. Wiggly Format Lab turns one great AI video into a reusable format with instructions, fixed assets, validation, rendering, and actual quality checks. Even Squidward could repeat it, provided someone labels every button. Squilliam News is available now as a runnable repo. Bring a promotion, add approved images and facts, validate before spending, then let the packaged renderer work. Inspect the result, approve the voice, and finalize. Open Format Lab and build something repeatable. See you there, Squiddy. Try not to rebuild the renderer.
